summary: Iteration 2 — full test pass on new features: invite-more, group start-ride, group recap, and WS audio relay. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases green (17 regression + 8 new). Frontend: sign-in → home → group room → recap flow all works. Sunset Cruise recap renders 175.5 km, 134 km/h, 3 riders as spec'd. Start ride from group room works ONLY when browser geolocation permission is granted; otherwise it silently swallows the permission error and the UI never leaves the 'Start my ride' state — a real UX gap for web users. Push-to-talk hint text 'Push-to-talk voice enabled' is present and the button becomes enabled after Join intercom. Regression tabs (Friends / Leaderboard / Profile) still render correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: When ride-tracker.start() throws (e.g., geolocation permission denied on web), the error is silently swallowed. Backend session IS created via /groups/{id}/start-ride but tracker.tracking stays false → 'Start my ride' button never flips to 'End my ride' and user gets zero feedback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/group/[id]/index.tsx:82-88
React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' emitted while rendering recap. Likely duplicate key in members / RouteMap list. Reference: /app/frontend/app/group/[id]/recap.tsx

integration_issues.issue: Frontend creates a backend session that is never surfaced. If tracker.start() fails after the POST, the orphaned active session lingers in DB (rider_id + ride_id, status=active). Suggest either (a) roll the session back on tracker failure, or (b) rely on GET /rides/active on group focus to hydrate rideSession state so the End button can appear even after tracker failure.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "Route '/[id]/index' with param 'id' was specified both in the path and as a param, removing from path". Emitted from router.replace/push calls that pass {id} inside pathname AND params. Reference: /app/frontend/app/group/[id]/index.tsx (leave/goToRecap)
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Recurs on every screen — likely in a shared component (Ionicons or Pressable wrapper).

action_items: Fix silent failure in /app/frontend/app/group/[id]/index.tsx onStartRide — surface tracker.start() errors via a toast/alert AND either rollback the backend session or hydrate rideSession from GET /rides/active so the End button can render even if geolocation is off.
De-dupe React keys in recap screen crew/RouteMap render to eliminate 'two children with the same key' warning.
Clean up expo-router calls that pass id both in the pathname string and the params object (e.g. router.replace(`/group/${id}/recap`) — drop the params or the pathname interpolation, not both).
Replace deprecated props.pointerEvents usage with style.pointerEvents across shared components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py end_ride() correctly gates parent-ride completion on `not parent.get('is_group_ride')` — confirmed by test_group_start_ride_idempotent_and_keeps_group_active. Good fix.
WS audio relay uses broadcast_except(sender) — sender does not echo their own audio. Verified in test_ws_audio_relayed_to_others_not_sender.
invite_more re-invites users whose status is 'declined'/'left' and no-ops on 'joined'/'invited'. Skips non-friends. Good.
recap's crew_avg_speed_kmh is a mean-of-means (avg of avg_speed_kmh per session) rather than a distance-weighted true average — matches spec but worth noting.

rca_of_issue: Start-my-ride UI-not-updating bug: In /app/frontend/app/group/[id]/index.tsx:79-88, onStartRide first POSTs /groups/{id}/start-ride (backend creates session, returns 200), then calls await tracker.start(). ride-tracker.ts:119-134 requires Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync() and throws if not granted. The outer try/catch in onStartRide swallows the error, so setRideSession(s) already ran (state has a session) but tracker.tracking is still false — and the JSX at line 230 gates on tracker.tracking, so 'End my ride' never appears. On real mobile this is a non-issue because location is granted; on web/headless test it looks broken. Mitigation: (1) call tracker.start() BEFORE the backend POST or in a try that rolls back the session on failure, (2) show an alert/toast on caught error, (3) render the End button on rideSession truthy regardless of tracker.tracking so users can at least end the orphan session.
